description: Search the "heldfast-churn-placeholder" knowledge base (/tmp/churn-q95j9dto/heldfast-churn-placeholder) for cited passages. Returns compact citations by default; send related questions together in queries (up to 5) to share one budget. Passages already returned in this session come back as short seen stubs. Each result has a citation (path, lines or page, chunk), an excerpt from its lines that hold the question's words (excerptLine gives the first line), pathContext when the configuration describes its folder, and weakEvidence when support is thin. An empty result means the base holds no evidence, so say so instead of guessing; a notice names question words that no indexed passage holds. When a question is hard to word, add searches: your own lex, vec, or hyde formulations of it, fused into one ranking. Expand one citation, or set compact:false, only when full text is needed.

compact.description: Default true: citations with short excerpts. false returns full passage text.

contextPaths.description: Limit hits to these heading paths, such as "Guide > Migration".

contextRadius.description: Neighbouring chunks added on each side of a hit, 0 to 3.

excludePaths.description: Skip files under these project-relative paths or globs.

explain.description: Adds the retrieval query and ranking signals; signals, not confidence.

includePaths.description: Search only files under these project-relative paths or globs.

intent.description: What the question is about, in a few words. It picks the excerpt lines; it never searches on its own.

maxBytes.description: Output budget in bytes for this call; the server caps it at its configured maximum.

maxChunksPerDocument.description: Most passages returned from one file. Default 1.

queries.description: Instead of query: up to 5 related questions answered together in one output budget.

query.description: One question, in natural language or with exact identifiers.

scope.description: A named source scope from the config; ragmir_status lists them.

searches.description: With query: your own formulations of the same need, fused with it into one ranking. lex: keywords, "exact phrase", -excluded word; vec: a paraphrase; hyde: a short passage that would answer it.

seen.description: Passages already returned in this session: collapse (default) to short stubs, include them in full again, or exclude them.

topK.description: Passages per question. Default 3; the server caps it.
